description: Sabaragamuwa Province - Liquidation of 08 Co-operative Societies of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the liquidation of multiple co-operative societies under provincial council authority. It deals with business/commercial matters (dissolution of registered business entities) rather than government personnel/structure, land, legal, electoral, public service, judicial, or other specialized categories. The content focuses on commercial registrations and business operations, fitting the Commercial classification (Type 6).
